reported_issues: Building and upgrade effects were difficult to understand.
Two plots per co-op player felt too restrictive.
Shared co-op income and spending felt frustrating.
changes: Expanded from two to four owned plots per co-op side.
Added separate P1/North and P2/South wallets, building income, kill rewards, tower spending, repair spending, and building spending.
Kept the gate truly shared by splitting fortification cost across both wallets.
Added exact current and next-level building output to build cards and concise role labels on the battlefield.
Added fast Skitter enemies, announced three-enemy surges, earlier Relicbacks, and night escalation callouts.
Moved plot opening to pointer release to prevent lower plots from click-through purchasing the wrong building.

eight_plot_layout.evidence: All eight plots, two wallets, tower cards, hearth, and build dock rendered without stage overflow at 1280x720.

evidence: North Plot 1 identified itself as W1-owned.
All four cards exposed role, exact level-one output, and cost.
A built Forge exposed CURRENT +1.9 metal/sec and NEXT +2.6 metal/sec before upgrade.
South Plot 1 remained open with four choices after pointer release.
Only W2 metal fell from 170 to 85 and only W2 displayed G +1.3/s; W1 remained 105 gold / 170 metal with no gold income.

economy_and_pacing_simulation.evidence: Selftest covers independent build deductions, owner-only Forge/Market income, split gate cost, eight slots, building summaries, and two-Skitter-plus-one-Brute surge composition.

browser_console.evidence: No warning or error entries during the expanded co-op journey.

remaining: Mike and Errol should retest pacing, plot proximity, wallet feel, and 5/10/20-minute balance on physical phones.
